title: Story with receipts
idea: Story with receipts: A factual chronology of decisions and artifacts carries the story, with evidence attached to each turning point.
audience: People who need to trace history within a marketing surface.
worksWellWhen: Origin or development explains why the current product exists.
avoidWhen: The story depends on fabricated founder moments or dates.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic ledger layout through its trace history priority and explicit commitment contract: Only show historical claims that have a legitimate recorded source.
navigation: Story with receipts keeps the current trace history context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A factual chronology of decisions and artifacts carries the story, with evidence attached to each turning point.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to trace history; origin or development explains why the current product exists.
composition.priority: Only show historical claims that have a legitimate recorded source.

imagery.role: Support the actual trace history context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Read as a compact chronology with expandable source detail.
Use a legible phone reading order; media never blocks the primary proposition.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the story with receipts structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no trace history content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Only show historical claims that have a legitimate recorded source.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized trace history content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Only show historical claims that have a legitimate recorded source.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active trace history context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure initial transfer, layout stability and real image decode cost at the chosen device.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
